other_conditions: Candidate must be a resident of Rajasthan
Applicant must be a regular student of a B.Ed training program in a government or recognized private institute in Rajasthan
Beneficiary must be divorced and abandoned (widow)
Applicants who have already obtained a B.Ed degree are ineligible
A minimum of 75% attendance in the institute is required
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other government scholarship or equivalent scheme
benefits_summary: Fee reimbursement of ₹17,880 for the B.Ed course.
